description: This PHP source file defines a custom form type class LocationType for Symfony forms, relevant for location input fields that include address, latitude, longitude, and radius. It includes methods for configuring options, building the form, and customizing the form view, with dependencies on external Symfony components.

classes.name: LocationType
classes.description: A custom Symfony form type for handling location data, extending a base TextType, that includes configuration options and methods to build and render location input fields with map and geocoder integration.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type, including 'compound', 'type', 'item', 'location_object', and other location-specific parameters.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form structure, adding fields for address components and applying view transformers to convert between data representations.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Customizes the form view variables, particularly for rendering the form with location data and associated options.

methods.name: finishView
methods.description: Finalizes the view by setting HTML attributes such as data-geocoder-type and CSS classes based on options.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for form block naming, defaulting to 'location'.
